## Summary

What changed and why, in two or three sentences.

## Scope

- [ ] api
- [ ] web
- [ ] mobile
- [ ] packages
- [ ] docs / ci

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is a Conventional Commit (`feat(api): ...`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated (request specs for API endpoints)
- [ ] `packages/types` regenerated if the OpenAPI spec changed
- [ ] No secrets, no `.env` files
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or architecture changed (no em dashes)
- [ ] Screenshots or recording attached for UI changes

## Notes for review

Anything risky, migrations, follow-ups.
